messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx + timeouts observed in prod/us-east-1 for /v1/generate
incident-bot: metric snapshot: 5xx_rate=17.8% over 2m, p95_wait=9.6s, AlertID=A-2026-9988

mike_oncall: paging in. I'm on it. @anya_sre can you confirm on SRE side?

anya_sre: I'm watching. scheduler queues are ballooning; batch wait times show HOL congestion. A few scheduler pods report repeated OOM-ish behavior — GPU mem pressure + long GC spikes. grabbing logs now.

mike_oncall: quick customer triage: any particular tenants spiking errors?

lia_prod: Support telemetry: three tenants (acme-inc, novaai, sandbox-team) make up ~58% of failed attempts. Failures are a mix of 504 gateway timeouts and 502 upstream rejects.

jordan_eng: from ingress traces: requests stuck in batcher queue > 10s then gateway abort. sample:
```
[2026-03-15T22:10:02Z] req=req_5d9e model=redwood-7b batch_wait_ms=10345 code=504 route=gateway-1
```
Looks correlated with extremely long context_length header on those requests.

anya_sre: hypothesis: runaway context lengths caused KV cache bloat per-request, causing memory contention and slower batch processing -> head-of-line.

mike_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) enforce shorter max_queue_ms to fail fast 2) reroute heavy tenants to smaller model 3) scale scheduler/batcher replicas 4) evict oldest queued batches preemptively 5) shift some traffic to another region. Agree to apply in that order?

lia_prod: agreed. I'll notify acme-inc & novaai (they're prod-sla) with a heads-up and fallback plan.

ops-bot: Runbook: set batcher.max_queue_ms=7000 for prod/us-east-1
ops-bot: Command executed: configctl apply --env=prod --path=batcher.max_queue_ms --value=7000

mike_oncall: scaling scheduler replicas now to relieve backlog

jordan_eng: run: `kubectl -n redwood-prod scale deploy/scheduler --replicas=7` — pods coming up. Also lowering per-model kv_max_entries for redwood-7b to avoid huge memory per-request: `modelctl set redwood-7b kv_max_entries=200000`

anya_sre: starting a controlled eviction: dry-run first to surface candidate request ids > 9s waiting.

ops-bot: batcherctl dry-run evict --env=prod --region=us-east-1 --threshold-ms=9000 -> 920 candidates (sample: rq_f21b, rq_c7a1, rq_4d0e)

mike_oncall: proceed with evicting the top 700 oldest to free HOL blocking, keep logs of evicted IDs.

ops-bot: batcherctl evict --env=prod --region=us-east-1 --policy oldest --count=700 -> completed.

lia_prod: initial customer update: acme-inc ok with fallback to redwood-3b, novaai accepted mitigation. sandbox-team is test, lower priority.

jordan_eng: routing split for heavy tenants to redwood-3b:
```
routingctl apply --region us-east-1 --tenants acme-inc,novaai,sandbox-team --target redwood-3b --mode emergency
```

anya_sre: metric check 90s after evict+scale: p95 latency for successful requests dropped from 2.9s -> 1.2s, 5xx rate down to ~4.5%. Two scheduler pods still showing elevated GPU mem pressure; I'm cordoning them for rolling restart.

mike_oncall: cordon and drain commands?

jordan_eng: `kubectl -n redwood-prod cordon scheduler-xyz && kubectl -n redwood-prod delete pod scheduler-xyz` — restarts in flight.

lia_prod: support update: acme-inc reported degraded UX during ~15m window, novaai similar. Sending incident advisory and CS will follow with postmortem timeline.

anya_sre: root-cause narrow: we allowed older clients to submit arbitrary context_length without admission checks; some clients sent giant context windows triggering large per-request KV allocations and slowdowns. Fix: short-term enforce a hard max context cap in the request admission layer.

mike_oncall: agreed actions:
- immediate: keep reduced batcher.max_queue_ms, evictions, fallback routing until stable
- short-term (24-72h): admission control cap + default model kv limits
- medium-term: per-request KV metrics, autoscaling KV shards, better circuit breaker for tenants that exceed per-request budget

ops-bot: Incident log created: incident/1769998888 status=mitigated; monitoring=true

mike_oncall: status update: marked mitigated at 22:24 UTC. We'll monitor for 2h then transition to postmortem. Peak 5xx ~17.8%, impact window ~22m, notable tenants notified. Leaving thread for postmortem doc.

support-lead: I'll own customer comms and coordinate RCA with PMs.

anya_sre: filing bug for admission control change + default model config update. thanks all :thumbsup:

mike_oncall: closing active mitigation loop. followups in tickets: INF-4721 (admission control), INF-4722 (kv-metrics), CS-2198 (customer comms).
